subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Reconhecer características da conversação espontânea presencial, respeitando os turnos de fala, selecionando e utilizando, durante a conversação, formas de tratamento adequadas, de acordo com a situação e a posição do interlocutor.

components.description_pt: Identificar características da conversa espontânea face a face
components.description_en: Identify characteristics of spontaneous face-to-face conversation
components.cc_component_description: Identify characteristics that distinguish formal style from informal style in writing

components.description_pt: Seguir regras acordadas para alternância de turnos em discussões em grupo
components.description_en: Follow agreed-upon rules for taking turns during group discussions
components.cc_component_description: Follow agreed-upon rules for taking turns during group discussions

components.description_pt: Selecionar formas de tratamento apropriadas ao papel e situação do interlocutor
components.description_en: Select forms of address appropriate to the interlocutor's role and situation
components.cc_component_description: Choose language and style appropriate to the audience, purpose, and context of communication

components.description_pt: Usar formas de tratamento apropriadas consistentemente durante a conversa
components.description_en: Use appropriate forms of address consistently during conversation
components.cc_component_description: Use appropriate eye contact, adequate volume, and clear pronunciation during oral presentations

cc_matches.description: Follow agreed-upon rules for discussions (e.g., gaining the floor in respectful ways, listening to others with care, speaking one at a time about the topics and texts under discussion).
Establish and maintain a formal style.
Use knowledge of language and its conventions when writing, speaking, reading, or listening.

Present claims and findings, emphasizing salient points in a focused, coherent manner with relevant evidence, sound valid reasoning, and well-chosen details; use appropriate eye contact, adequate volume, and clear pronunciation.
